notes: borussia.de renders page bodies in the browser from its own GraphQL API (https://www.borussia.de/graphql, Strapi pages and articles by slug); a plain HTML fetch of these URLs returns only the title and teaser, so evidence phrases are in the rendered page/API response, not the raw HTML. Fiscal year is the calendar year: 2025 revenue about EUR 189.3m (2024: EUR 184.8m); net loss after tax about EUR 3.9m (pre-tax not stated); equity EUR 44.94m at 31 Dec 2025. Wages, EBITDA and net debt not stated in the club's release. Not in the Deloitte Money League 2026 top 30 or Forbes' 2026 top 30, so no valuation. Owner of the stadium itself is not stated (the GmbH holds 39.4% of PPG Nordpark GmbH, the parking company). Stadium renamed ista-Borussia-Park from 1 July 2026 under a naming partnership with ista running at least to 30 June 2031 (commercial deal, no amount disclosed). REUTER main sponsor since 2024/25, extended to 2027; PUMA outfitter since 2018, extended in 2022. Supervisory board chaired by Michael Hollmann. No ownership or financing transactions since 2015 found (deals empty). Social follower counts not found on a citable page.
